summary: Frontend-only verification of resume-last-song, first-tap (cv-hide pointerdown vs click), scroll-lock robustness, Zodiac sheet, What's Next disclaimer, Eco + floating 3D renders & Eco settings card, account privacy on /_sbtest.html, and regression smoke. All review scenarios pass on https://treesh-phase5.preview.emergentagent.com.
tests_executed: RESUME (390x844, iPhone preload=none shim via add_init_script, song chelly-banqz-shake-it-some-mo, LS seed treesh_resume t=60): mini player shows Shake It Some Mo / Chelly Banqz, state.currentTime=60, audio.readyState=0 at init. Tap #mini [data-act=toggle-play] -> after 3s audio.currentTime=62.78, after 5s=64.78 (advancing). Open NP via [data-act=mini-open], toggle lyrics -> 60 [data-act=lyric-seek] rows present. Tap lyric t=81.82 -> ct=83.25 after 1.5s, ct=88.25 after +5s (no snap back to ~60). Pause -> LS treesh_resume.t updated to 88.3. Reload with t=30, open NP, toggle lyrics, tap lyric t=61.09 BEFORE play -> audio paused at ct=61.09, then play -> ct=64.42 after 3.5s (started at lyric line, not 30). PASS

FIRST TAP (390x844, Eco ON, song savionce-never-rock-version): startGame() opens game chat; html.classList contains 'cv-hide'. Dispatch pointerdown-only on [data-act=game-close] -> cv-hide unchanged (True before, True after). Full click on [data-act=game-close] -> cv-hide=false, state.game=null. ARCADE: openGameFrame('frea') shows [data-act=game-frame-close]; pointerdown-only -> cv-hide unchanged; full click -> cv-hide=false. touchHoverFix() runs without errors after window.matchMedia('(hover:none)') override. PASS

SCROLL LOCK (390x844): #modal with <div style='display:none'> + syncScrollLock() -> body.style.position='' (not fixed). state.npOpen=true with empty #np + syncScrollLock() -> ''. openConfirm('T','D',()=>{}) -> body.style.position='fixed' after 300ms; closeModal() -> position='' after 800ms. For each panel open+close [NP, queue, search, profile, settings, What's Next, zodiac] -> body.style.position='' after close and window.scrollBy(0,400) advances scrollY. DESKTOP 1920x800: NP open+close -> scroll works. mkTrack(()=>{},()=>{}) + synthetic touchstart/touchmove -> _mkTouchLock null (not locked), touchmove.defaultPrevented=false. PASS

ZODIAC (800x800): zhOpen() -> .zh-sheet left=90 right=710 (centered on 800w). Setting inline transition='none' transform='translate3d(0,200px,0)' -> left=90 right=710 unchanged (horizontally centered). Mouse drag down on .zh-grab (y+300px) -> sheet closes, body.style.position='' (unlocked). PASS

WHAT'S NEXT DISCLAIMER (390x844, Eco OFF, during What's Next game): [data-testid=game-disclaimer] visible with text 'Just a game · not the real artists texting', contains .wc-disc-dot with computed animationName='wcDiscDot' (dot blinks), positioned below .wc-head (belowHead=True). PASS - note: dot animation is 'wcDiscDot' not 'wcDiscBlink' as mentioned in request; both achieve the blinking effect and the spec appears to be satisfied semantically.

ECO + FLOATING 3D (390x844): Eco ON (treesh_eco='true', treesh_eco_user='"on"') -> html.eco=true. On Studios: .st3-main / .st3-sat / .st3-sway all getComputedStyle(..).animationName='none'. On Game: .st3-main / .st3-sway all 'none'. Eco OFF (clean LS, treesh_eco='false', treesh_eco_user='"off"') -> html.eco=false. On Game: .st3-main animations='st3Float' (animating). On Studios: .st3-main='st3Float', .st3-sat='st3Float2' (animating). Settings > Appearance: [data-testid=eco-card] renders with [data-testid=eco-toggle], [data-testid=eco-fps]='43' (number), [data-testid=eco-tag]='New'/'On'; eco card top-y=4075 < performance mode top-y=4311 (Eco above Performance). Clicking [data-testid=eco-toggle] turns html.eco=true and tag->'On'. PASS

ACCOUNT PRIVACY (/_sbtest.html, 390x844): seeded __mock_sb_db {users: a@test.com/secret123/ua1 confirmed}, treesh_profile with space.about='Hello space'. idbPut u-secret1 ('My Secret Song' / 'Secret Me'); loadUserSongs() -> USER_SONGS=['u-secret1']. toggleFav('u-secret1') + toggleFav(catalogId) + createPlaylist('Mix',[catalogId,'u-secret1']). sbAuthOpen('signin') -> fill [data-testid=sb-auth-email/password] -> click [data-testid=sb-auth-submit] with expect_navigation. CLOUD JSON: 'u-secret1'=False, 'My Secret Song'=False, 'Secret Me'=False, catalog_id present, 'Mix' present. LOCAL after signin: favs=['u-secret1', catalog_id], Mix.songIds=[catalog_id,'u-secret1']. Signout via openProfile+settingsEditProfile -> [data-testid=pf-acct-signout] -> [data-testid=confirm-ok] -> Welcome shown, treesh_um_stash present and contains 'u-secret1'. Sign back in via [data-testid=onboarding-signin] -> RESTORED: favs=['u-secret1', catalog_id], Mix has both, USER_SONGS=['u-secret1'], treesh_um_stash='{}' (empty), space.about='Hello space'. PASS

REGRESSION SMOKE (390x844): #/ (Library), #/icons, #/studios, #/game, #/settings all render body text > 500 chars. Mini player opens via playSong + state.npOpen=true; closeNP() closes npOpen=false. No non-benign console errors (only 1 benign 404 for favicon/manifest resource).
critical_code_review_comments: What's Next disclaimer dot uses animationName='wcDiscDot' not 'wcDiscBlink' as mentioned in the review request. The dot does blink visibly and the disclaimer is readable, so the user-facing requirement is met. If the exact keyframe name matters for QA/testing, consider adding/aliasing 'wcDiscBlink'. Non-blocking.

mkTrack test: window._mkTouchLock is `null` (never set) after mkTrack+touchstart+touchmove, rather than the exact `===false` mentioned in the review. The important assertion (touchmove.defaultPrevented===false) holds, so no scroll hijack is in effect. Non-blocking.
test_credentials: Mock only: a@test.com / secret123 seeded into __mock_sb_db on /_sbtest.html.
seed_data_creation: Per-scenario: treesh_onboarded, treesh_profile (nickname:Tester, birthday 2000-01-01, space.about 'Hello space' for sbtest), treesh_whatsnew_off, treesh_eco(_user), treesh_resume. On /_sbtest.html: __mock_sb_db with user ua1, idbPut u-secret1 custom song, toggleFav+createPlaylist('Mix').
context_for_next_testing_agent: (1) SONGS/USER_SONGS/GAMES are top-level `let` bindings NOT on window; always use bare identifier in page.evaluate. (2) Catalog songs without `audioUrl` or lacking enough synced-lyric lines fail startGame() with 'Not enough lyrics' toast; use e.g. 'savionce-never-rock-version' or 'chelly-banqz-shake-it-some-mo' for lyric/game tests. (3) Resume LS format: {id,t,q,b,at}. Audio preload=none shim must be set via add_init_script BEFORE reload. Lyric rows render only after clicking [data-act=toggle-lyrics] inside #np. (4) openConfirm sets body.style.position='fixed' after a microtask (not sync), poll >=300ms. (5) sb_mock auth: form inputs are [data-testid=sb-auth-email/password/submit] (ids sb-email/sb-pw). Signin reloads the page -> use expect_navigation. Sign out from state.settingsEditProfile=true + openProfile() -> [data-testid=pf-acct-signout] -> [data-testid=confirm-ok]; it also triggers navigation. (6) Eco OFF requires localStorage.clear() first since treesh_eco (hard) can override user override on repeat reloads. (7) Zodiac grab handle is .zh-grab; mouse drag down closes sheet.
